about: The day's 300 (M2 sprint 10, step 2; plan chapter 05, 2.3-2.4), written by tools/town/roster.py from data/population.json, seeded by the date: each drawn person's who (the member's id), household, house, community, archetype (role), sex, age, why (walker, named, drawn), dress, and day: walker (today's walkers, their days the street graph's own), shol (Shöl's own and those who come into it today, from their door or their way in: from), hejie (Hejie's own about Hejie, from their doors), samkha (Samkha's own about Samkha), court (the parties to the Pönpo's morning hearing: case, its minutes; felt, 1 or 2), scene (placed by their own scenes), away (in their own district until the walkers' ground reaches it).
